create_mattermost_adapter: create a MattermostAdapter instance with a PlatformConfig to connect to a self-hosted Mattermost server
connect_mattermost_bot: connect a MattermostAdapter to authenticate the bot and start the WebSocket listener for real-time events
send_mattermost_message: send a message to a Mattermost channel with optional thread support and automatic message truncation
send_mattermost_file: send an image, document, voice, or video file to a Mattermost channel by downloading from URL or uploading from local path
edit_mattermost_message: edit an existing Mattermost post by its message ID with optional finalization
